releases.body:
## Fixes (issue #7 follow-up)

Fixes the follow-up reported in https://github.com/earneet/opencode-worktree-isolation/issues/7#issuecomment-5690936847: v0.4.2's zombie-binding fix did not cover the main path of "background task sub-sessions completing normally" — `worktree_merge apply` was blocked 100% by `inherited: true` bindings of finished sub-agents.

### Inherited sub-agent bindings now have a full lifecycle

- **Event-driven release (root fix)**: new `event` hook — `session.idle` releases a sub-agent's inherited binding the moment its task finishes; `session.deleted` releases any binding. Audited as `binding_released`. If a released sub-agent resumes later, lazy parent-chain inheritance re-binds it transparently (self-healing).
- **Guard semantics corrected**: merge/cleanup now refuse only when an *independent* session holds a binding for the worktree. Inherited bindings are, by construction, descendants of the owner session — they are released along with the worktree instead of blocking it.
- **Cascade clearing**: after a worktree is removed (merge/cleanup) or detected missing, every binding pointing at it is cleared, including the in-process inheritance cache — finished background tasks can never leave residue in the state file, across restarts.

### Cleanup preview / merged-detection fixes

- `git branch --merged` prefixes linked-worktree branches with `+`; the old parser only stripped `*`, so **every** managed worktree was labeled `unmerged` and non-force `worktree_cleanup apply` always skipped them. Both markers are now stripped (lookahead-guarded so `+foo`-style branch names stay intact); detached-HEAD pseudo entries are skipped.
- `worktree_cleanup(action="preview")` aggregates per worktree (`sessions=N`, no duplicate lines) and reaps bindings whose directories are gone.
- The apply loop processes each worktree exactly once, driven by its direct binding (correct for both `external` and `git-common` state backends).

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/earneet/opencode-worktree-isolation/compare/v0.4.2...v0.4.3

## Fixes (issue #7)

### Windows: worktree removal 100% failure (`Filename too long`)

- `git worktree remove` now has a fallback chain: on Windows, `robocopy <empty> <worktree> /MIR` (long-path-capable) + `rmSync`; on POSIX, `fs.rmSync` with retries
- Fallback success → `worktree prune` + branch deletion + unbind continue; no more manual robocopy ritual after every merge in bun monorepos
- If both deletion paths fail, the error message spells out the exact manual recovery commands and the still-bound state

### Zombie session bindings

- Bindings whose worktree directory no longer exists now auto-expire on the next tool call: auto-unbind + `binding_expired` audit entry + warning — read/write/edit immediately fall back to the repo root instead of rewriting into a dead path
- `worktree_cleanup` handles already-missing worktrees directly (prune + delete branch + unbind)

### Improvements

- `worktree_merge(action="preview")` lists the files that will be auto-committed (up to 20)

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/earneet/opencode-worktree-isolation/compare/v0.4.1...v0.4.2

## Fix

- **\.git\ path check now uses path-segment matching** — \.github/\, \.gitignore\, \.gitattributes\, \.gitmodules\ are no longer mistaken for the \.git\ directory and wrongly blocked (\ead\/\write\/\edit\ deny, \glob\/\grep\ throw, allow-list rejection, skipped worktree rewrite)
- New \isDotGitPath()\: \.git\ must be a complete path segment (ends with \/.git\ or contains \/.git/\); real \.git\ blocking behavior unchanged
- 7 new regression tests; full suite 177/177 pass on Windows/Linux/macOS

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/earneet/opencode-worktree-isolation/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1

## What's New

### Multi-session safety + strict modes (borrowed from zcode-worktree-guard)

- **\strictWrites\** — block Write/Edit to the main checkout without an active worktree binding
- **\strictGitOps\** — block \git push/merge/rebase/pull/checkout/branch -d\ on protected branches (\master\/\main\ always protected)
- **\mainWriteWhitelist\** — permanent glob whitelist for repo-level config/docs writes
- **\worktree_allow\** tool — temporary per-call escape hatch with TTL + audit log
- **Subagent inheritance** — \	ask()\ subagents inherit the parent session's worktree binding
- Dangling-reference guards: cleanup/merge refuse to delete worktrees still bound by other sessions

### Fixes

- Cross-platform CI: Linux + macOS added to test matrix (#1, #2)
- \
orm()\ cross-separator path matching on POSIX (#5)

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/earneet/opencode-worktree-isolation/compare/v0.3.1...v0.4.0
